narrator.how: calm and clear, a little amused and a little sad, unhurried — like a Tove Jansson book read aloud on an August evening

papa.how: solemn and loud, a captain on his own deck, fond of his own stories; when he is moved, or alone, suddenly quiet and almost shy

mama.how: warm, light and quick, never complaining; whatever hurts she says lightly and turns at once to the tea

troll.how: a boy, soft and low, very few words, looking at the floor; stubborn underneath

my.how: a tiny girl: sharp, quick, mocking, delighted with everything that is interesting; never sorry for anyone

fisher.how: old, flat and slow, hoarse from the wind; a few words about the weather, never looking at whom he speaks to
